title: **Make the estate coverage cell reflect fatal
notes: one synthetic row and `{ id: 'coverage', level: 'error' }` prints `cov ok`
while its footer says zero fully wired. The column checks only
returns `coverage` for missing or unreadable test wiring. Smallest next
step: include every fatal coverage finding in the cell predicate and add a
synthetic formatter regression covering an absent test script, without
making informational workspace-delegation findings fail. No application
coverage result is implied by a green cell until corrected.
result: Fatal coverage findings now render FAIL in the estate coverage column; informational workspace delegation remains nonfailing. Independent read-only review returned no findings.
evidence: Regression failed before the fix (1 failed, 10 passed), then pnpm --filter @syntopica/create-baseline exec vitest run tests/estate.test.mjs --maxWorkers=1 passed 11/11; pnpm --filter @syntopica/create-baseline test --maxWorkers=1 passed 200/200 tests with coverage; package lint and targeted Prettier checks passed.
